注意区域

A defined area where vessels must navigate with particular caution, often due to traffic convergence, hazards, or complex navigation conditions. Special rules or recommendations may apply.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 注意区域?

In this glossary, 注意区域 refers to: A defined area where vessels must navigate with particular caution, often due to traffic convergence, hazards, or complex navigation conditions. Special rules or recommendations may apply.

How is 注意区域 used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "本船は注意区域に進入中。すべての船舶は減速し、厳重に見張りし、現地警告を遵守してください。必要ならVTSに報告。"

Why does 注意区域 matter in maritime?

注意区域 matters because it supports clear communication in Nav contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses 注意区域?

注意区域 is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does 注意区域 belong to?

In this glossary, 注意区域 is grouped under Nav. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A defined area where vessels must navigate with particular caution, often due to traffic convergence, hazards, or complex navigation conditions. Special rules or recommendations may apply.

Operational example

Vessel entering precautionary area. All ships are advised to reduce speed, maintain sharp lookout, and comply with local navigation warnings. Report to VTS if necessary.

Localized term

注意区域

Localized example

本船は注意区域に進入中。すべての船舶は減速し、厳重に見張りし、現地警告を遵守してください。必要ならVTSに報告。
